name: vox_collage
label: Vox Collage (paper-cut editorial)
description: Vox-style editorial paper collage: crumpled paper, torn edges with white core, newsprint strips, engraved/halftone cut-outs with die-cut borders, masking tape, one loud accent, stop-motion on twos.

assets.styleBlock: Vintage editorial collage cut-out in the style of a Vox explainer video: detailed black-and-white copperplate ENGRAVING / etching with fine crosshatching and halftone dots, high contrast, printed-on-paper look with subtle paper grain. Only ONE spot color allowed: {ACCENT_NAME} ({ACCENT}) used sparingly on a single key element; everything else strictly black ink on off-white paper (#F4EFE4).

prompts.cutout: {STYLE} Subject: {SUBJECT}. {ACCENT_RULE} Isolated single object, centered, fully visible with generous margin, clean silhouette suitable for a die-cut sticker, {BG}. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no drop shadow.
prompts.portrait: {STYLE} Subject: {SUBJECT}, shown as an anonymous engraved figure (not a real or identifiable person), three-quarter view, bust crop. {ACCENT_RULE} {BG}. No text, no logos, no watermark.
prompts.background: {STYLE} Full-bleed background plate: {SUBJECT}. Composition leaves the central area calm for overlaid typography; crumpled paper texture visible. Vertical 2:3. No text, no logos, no watermark.
prompts.texture: Flat top-down scan of {SUBJECT}, evenly lit, no perspective, no objects, seamless-looking, high detail paper fibers. No text, no logos.

assets.accentRule: Paint ONLY {ACCENT_ELEMENT} in flat {ACCENT_NAME} ({ACCENT}) ink; all other parts black-and-white engraving.
assets.noAccentRule: Strictly black-and-white engraving, no color at all.
assets.chromaBg: on a perfectly flat solid pure chroma-key background {CHROMA} with no gradient, no shadow and no texture
